item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: chickpea patties, served with summer rice salad with vegetables, topped with pea shoots. Served with remoulade and dill dressing. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: Fried courgette fritters with a rich Greek salad. Served with tzatziki and potatoes tossed in a lemon and pepper vinaigrette. Gluten-free option available. (1+2+6+11+15) Thai chicken satay: roasted chicken with peanut sauce, jasmine rice and Thai roasted broccoli. Served with Thai cucumber salad and toasted spiced bread. Gluten-free option available. (1+4+7+8+9+13+15) Thai tofu satay: roasted tofu with peanut sauce, jasmine rice and Thai roasted broccoli. Served with Thai cucumber salad and toasted spiced bread. Gluten-free option available. (1+4+7+8+9+13+15) A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Potato frittata with grilled peppers and a herb salad with marjoram, parsley, frisée and Parmesan. (2+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Burritos with sweet potato, black beans, cheese and chipotle dressing. Served with cabbage salad and crème fraîche dressing. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: vegetarian hash with edamame and mushrooms, topped with a fried egg and chopped chives. Served with HP sauce, béarnaise cream and a haricots verts salad with red onion and slow-baked tomatoes. (1+2+7+11)
